evals.prompt: I changed the chat system prompt to be more concise — did I make it worse?
evals.expected_output: Triggers the skill in Run & interpret / Compare mode: checks the test DB and a model key, proposes pnpm eval chat --compare (baseline) or a before/after run pair, reads the run file and explains per-case changes from the judges' rationales without editing any expectation.

evals.prompt: Set up evals for our new invoice-extraction agent
evals.expected_output: Triggers Author mode: asks what a good extraction looks like before writing anything, recommends SchemaJudge on the agent's output schema plus Contains/Rubric, drafts 5–10 cases into apps/evals/datasets/<name>.jsonl with an explanation per case, writes a suite with describeCases and agentHarness, then runs it.

evals.prompt: A customer gave three thumbs down on research answers yesterday, can we turn those into tests?
evals.expected_output: Triggers Harvest mode: runs pnpm cli feedback list --rating down, warns that promoted cases are tenant data before evals promote, drafts corrected expectations and rubrics, and stops for human sign-off on every gold expectation.

evals.prompt: Get the knowledge-chat rubric score above 0.9 but don't spend more than three tries
evals.expected_output: Triggers the Improve loop: holds out ~1/3 of cases, mines failures on the rest, proposes one prompt/tool change at a time, re-runs both splits, keeps or reverts, stops at the target or after 3 iterations, and never edits expected outputs or loosens a judge.
